facts.text: The party must bring Warwick metal from the Dwarven mine to the north. In exchange, Warwick lent them his mithril chain shirt and plays Sir Phidipaldi's lyre every night while they are gone.
The party must return Warwick's mithril chain shirt, which was his grandfather's armor. Warwick holds Sir Phidipaldi's plate armor and lyre as collateral until then.
Wayman Tisdale wears Warwick's mithril chain shirt, on loan. It greatly improves his protection and halves the damage he takes from magic weapons and spells.
A natural-looking cave-in seals the Dwarven mine's entrance, blocking the party from getting metal for Warwick. It can be dug through, and Dunk has already bashed partway into it.
